memory.status: Guest allocator budget committed and tested. Go runtime guard (soft GC target + 100ms sampled fail-stop) live passed: guest UDP socket allocation terminated only its Sentry at 86,083,864 bytes vs 67,108,864 budget. New transport helpers each have 512MiB RLIMIT_AS.
memory.limits: Guest pages have allocator enforcement. Runtime guard permits transient overshoot; host kernel allocations, systrap mappings and immutable shared image cache are outside the Go guard. No claim of a host cgroup-equivalent total RSS ceiling.
memory.test_failures: Bazel boot fixture uses nontraversable /tmp. Same built boot_test binary passed with TMPDIR=/local/gvisor-public-testtmp; see runs/gvisor-boot-direct-public-tests.log. Earlier anonymous fault and test teardown issues fixed.
